text_block_list.name: Lou
text_block_list.text: Uwaaah!!! Are you really sure I can pick as many treats as I want from this entire store?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁ～～～～っ！
ここにあるおかし、
ほんとうに好きなだけ
選んでいいんですか！？

text_block_list.name: Lou
text_block_list.text: It's the first time I've been to such a place! It's almost like I'm in a dream... Huh? Maybe I really am? Well, not that it really matters, does it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなとこ
初めて来たですよ！
まるで
夢みたいで……
あれ？　
本当に夢かも？
まぁ、
こまかいことはどうでもいいですね！

text_block_list.name: Lou
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm so happy! Umm, umm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
うれしいですぅ！
ん
～と、
え～っと……

text_block_list.name: Lou
text_block_list.text: There's some gum packs... kinako sticks... and even some candy paste! Also this and that... I want all the things on the shelves too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
当たり付きガムに～、
きなこ棒に～……
あっ、
ねりあめもあるですぅ！
それからこれと、
これと……
ここの棚
ぜ～んぶほしいですぅ！

text_block_list.name: Lou
text_block_list.text: ...Are you really sure this is okay, {0}-san? The last time we went to buy some candies, you said you didn't have any money on you, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……{0}さん、
ほんとうに大丈夫です？
前
おかし屋に行ったときは、
お金ぜんぜん持ってないって
いってたですよね？

text_block_list.name: Lou
text_block_list.text: {0}-san...! Did you really save so much money for Lou...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん……！
ルゥのために、
そこまでおこづかいを貯めて……！？

text_block_list.name: Lou
text_block_list.text: To think you're throwing such a grand celebration for me... I'm so grateful! In that case... Granny! Bring out all the sweets you have!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなに祝ってくれるなんて
かんげきですぅ！
そういうことなら……
店員の
おばあさん！
もっともっと
おかしを持ってくるですぅ～！

text_block_list.name: Lou
text_block_list.text: EEEEKKKKKKK!? Where did you even get such a thing...? Eh? The reason you got all that money for Lou... was under the promise you'd also make her study harder...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひ
いいっっ！？
どうしてこんなものが……
えっ？
おこづかいは……
ルゥをたくさん勉強させるかわりに、
てにいれた……？

text_block_list.name: Lou
text_block_list.text: What kind of trick deal even is that!? Ugh... Lou just wants to eat as many sweets as she can for the rest of her life! I don't need this other birthday present!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんですかその取引は～っ！？
うぅ……
ルゥはただ、
おかしを一生ぶん食べたいだけなのに！
こんな誕生日プレゼントは
いらないですよぉ～っ！

text_block_list.name: Lou
text_block_list.text: Enough talk about that! *sigh* This really is a different world...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういう話はいいんですぅ！
はぁ……
ほんとうに
せちがらい
世の中ですね……

text_block_list.name: Lou
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll think something up about my homework later, after I'm done eating my sweets... which you're eating too, {0}-san! Now that we've come this far together, let's also think of a way out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
宿題をどうするかは
おかしを食べてから考えるとして……
{0}さんも
おかしを食べるですぅ！
こうなったら、
一緒にかいけつさくを
考えるですよ！
